extracted.name: Fried Banana - with grated cheese and palm sugar on top
extracted.description: Great recipe for Fried Banana - with grated cheese and palm sugar on top.
instruction_lines: Prepare batter, in a bowl, mix all-purpose flour, corn starch with salt, and water until no lumps. Then add in oil or melted butter.
Dip banana into the batter then deep fry at medium heat until nice golden color
Place fried banana on a kitchen towel to remove excess oil. Then transfer on a plate.
Grate some cheese and sprinkle good amount of palm/brown sugar on top. Ready to serve.
